name: Fiacca Marguerite
original_name: フィアッカ・マルグリット
source: [spoiler]Elder sister of [url=/c12786]Cynthia Marguerite[/url]. Old lunarian from the times of the Oedipus Wars, currently consists in just a personality that's transferred from body to body each generation; her current vessel is Wreathlit. Makes sure that lost technology doesn't fall in wrong hands, and is one of the most important persons of the Moon Church.[/spoiler]
